name: The majority voted against an Australian Greens [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-12-05.289.3), which means it failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 14, page 10 (after line 6), after subclause (2), insert:* > > *(2A) If a member of the Committee is a person who has direct contemporary experience of living with a low income and economic exclusion, that member is to be paid allowances appropriate to the circumstances of the member and having regard to the time and expertise the member contributes to the work of the Committee, including:* > >> *(a) any preparation undertaken by the member for a meeting of the Committee; and* >> >> *(b) any other activity undertaken by the member relevant to the Committee's function.*
